hits.query: Article 30.5(m) at least two different specifications of dry-weather tyres unless intermediate or wet used
hits.text: Article 30.5(m) requires each driver to use at least two different dry-weather tyre specifications in the race, unless the driver used intermediate or wet-weather tyres during the race. After an intermediate or wet stint a car may finish on a single dry compound. In a dry race, failing to use a second dry specification leads to disqualification, unless the race is suspended and cannot be restarted, in which case 30 seconds are added to the driver's elapsed time. The paragraph letter differs by year: 30.5(n) in the 2023 regulations, 30.5(m) in 2024 and 2025.
